common_examples.quote: Disable the FSM while a transmission is in progress.
Force the FSM to clear its current operation while actively transmitting to confirm that it returns to idle without completing the remaining shifts.
Attempt to recover from the error by applying a reset-like condition.
Execute back-to-back transmissions with varying data patterns.
When asserted, FSM immediately transitions to Idle, resetting all counters and outputs regardless of the current state.
